destination.objective: How does the visible transition between dark linear-patterned terrain and the brighter rough-textured patch relate to local relief?

science.question: How does the visible transition between dark linear-patterned terrain and the brighter rough-textured patch relate to local relief?
science.observationTask: Plan a single-waypoint imaging session: document local surface texture and linear-feature orientation, then relate the notes to the orbital crop and terrain context.
science.whyHere: Location S lies at the imaged boundary between contrasting textures. The same crop is covered by the co-registered HiRISE terrain model, so the question can be examined alongside measured relief.
science.observed: The marked crop contains repeated dark linear features next to a brighter irregular-textured patch.
science.interpretation: Investigate whether the contrast follows changes in surface texture, local relief or illumination. Gray levels alone do not identify material composition.

checks.observed: Image-supported question, fixed evidence window and original source references retained alongside the actual modeled plan.
